issues.title: Exact-bitmap BF pushed through CM compress offset
issues.hypothesis: FinalizeFilters (physical_hash_join.cpp:1059) builds a BF only when pushdown_column.storage_offset.IsNull() && !has_cast. When compressed materialization compresses a join key (__internal_compress_integral_*(x, off)), the probe scan gets min/max only. E0019 showed that in q04 the lineitem probe then stays at ~37.9M rows when ~2.3M would match. A previous run on this codebase measured the same blockage on q09: an exact-bitmap BF (the bitmap is built over the compressed HT keys, and the probe subtracts off before lookup) cut the orders scan from 15M to 2.94M rows, q09 -9..-14%, over two separate ports. The hashed BF variant was bench +4.7%, so use only the exact mode, where the offset shift is a trivial and safe integer subtraction.
issues.plan: 1) src/include/duckdb/planner/filter/bloom_filter.hpp: add `uint64_t key_offset = 0` (with SetKeyOffset) to BFTableFilter, and make the copy, equality and serialization paths carry it. 2) src/planner/filter/bloom_filter.cpp: in the exact-mode probe paths (the IsExact branches at ~177/229/337), subtract key_offset from the raw storage value before the range and bit test. Do this in the integer domain the exact-range check already uses, and test that value < off, or the subtraction underflowing, maps to 'not present'. Use HUGEINT or a wraparound-safe compare. 3) physical_hash_join.cpp FinalizeFilters: add a second branch for !has_cast-equivalent integral types, when storage_offset is non-null and join_condition==0. Call TrySetExactBloomFilter with the RAW (compressed, unshifted) min/max of the HT keys, not the offset-shifted values used for the min/max filters. Push the BF only if bf.IsExact() succeeded, and set key_offset = storage_offset cast to uint64. Never push a hashed BF through an offset. Note that has_cast is true here, because condition type (compressed UINTEGER etc.) != storage type. Gate on storage_offset non-null plus both types integral instead of !has_cast. 4) Keep deferred_bloom_filters handling identical to the existing branch. Verify on q04/q09 with EXPLAIN ANALYZE: the probe scan should show a BF and lower row counts. For correctness, compare counts with SET disabled_optimizers='join_filter_pushdown', including a key range that starts at a non-zero offset (CM only fires when the est. build is >=1M rows, so test tables need ~15M rows).
issues.expected_gain: q09 -9..-14% (prior measured), q04 -5..-15% (lineitem probe 37.9M→~2.3M rows), possibly q03/q05/q18 a few %. Geomean ~-1.5..-2.5%.
issues.generality: Any hash join on dense integer keys where an aggregate, sort or large-join materialization causes CM to compress the key. This is common for FK/PK joins on large fact tables. Joins with unselective builds may pay a BF probe cost, but the existing selectivity auto-disable covers that.
issues.risk: Medium. If the offset sign or underflow is handled wrongly, rows get pruned incorrectly and results are wrong, so test with a shifted key range. Header change to BFTableFilter.

dispatch: Exact-bitmap BF pushed through CM compress offset
output.memory:
## Memory (gen2)

## State
- gen1 (r1-r16): accepted E0001 JoinDependent rule order (q19), E0002 contains() selectivity (q09), E0003 perfect HJ RIGHT (q13), E0005 BF first key multi-key HJ (q09), E0006 key-set range filter through compress projs (q18), E0007 exact bitmap BF, E0011 semi-join estimate, E0012 OR-of-ranges mask, E0014 FSST simple decode + substring prefilter (q13), E0016 DELIM_GET-build BF (q22 -20%). Best 1.281x.
- gen2 r1+r2: E0017/E0018 (no CM on hash-join keys) RETIRED twice: +0.6%, then +3.0% with q14/q16/q18 slower and hidden validation REGRESSED. DEAD.
- gen2 r3: E0019 deliminate selective SEMI + RIGHT_SEMI/ANTI join filters: RETIRED. q04 -9.8% (3 runs: -8.7/-13/-16.5%), but the threshold for q04 is -20.7%. Hidden validation ok, and nothing got slower. It was a GOOD idea that fell short of the threshold. The blocker: the BF is not pushed through the CM offset (FinalizeFilters needs storage_offset null && !has_cast).
- gen2 r4: DISPATCHED "Exact-bitmap BF pushed through CM compress offset" (BFTableFilter key_offset + FinalizeFilters branch using RAW compressed min/max). Prior run measured q09 -9..-14%.
  - If it lands: RE-DISPATCH E0019 (deliminator SEMI) on top. With the BF reaching lineitem, q04 should pass -20%. The implementer notes for E0019 in the ledger describe the full diff (SelectionIsReplaceableByJoinFilter, NDF→= on non-null cols, RIGHT_SEMI/ANTI gate removal).
  - If it fails: check whether the BF actually reached the probe scan (EXPLAIN ANALYZE). If it did not, the implementation is bad, not the idea.
- Claude auto-memory (~/.claude/.../memory) holds results from a PREVIOUS evolve run on this codebase. Treat them as strong measured priors, not landed code.
- .dbe/issues.md: the first 3 issues (contains selectivity, perfect HJ RIGHT, BF through CM hashed) are stale. Ignore them. The "aggregate CM skip q13" issue is DEAD (it depended on E0017).

## q04 analysis
- q04 = EXISTS over lineitem with date-filtered orders. Base plan: RIGHT_DELIM_JOIN + DISTINCT agg + INNER HJ vs DELIM_SCAN + RIGHT_SEMI on IS NOT DISTINCT FROM.
- The scans are cheap (orders ~15ms, lineitem ~70ms wall). The time is in the delim/join machinery and the 37.9M-row probe.
- Delim join conditions are IS NOT DISTINCT FROM, and join filter pushdown skips NDF. E0019 converted NDF to = on non-null columns.

## Key finding: CM on join keys blocks the BF
- physical_hash_join.cpp:1059: BF only if !has_cast && storage_offset.IsNull(). A CM key has both an offset and a cast (UINTEGER vs storage BIGINT). Min/max are shifted via JoinFilterValueToStorage (:717).
- Exact BF: TrySetExactBloomFilter (physical_hash_join.cpp:896), BloomFilter::SetExactRange/IsExact (bloom_filter.hpp:37), probe paths in bloom_filter.cpp (~177/229/337), insert in join_hashtable.cpp:743.

## Measurement lessons
- dbe-tool sql: the first 2-3 runs of a query in a process are slow (warm-up). Alternate A/B/A/B.
- Do NOT wrap in count(*): it changes the plan. Use a temp view + `from v`.
- dbe-tool bash: no pipes, no shell variables, no $(...).
- Bench noise is ±10-20% per template on identical code (q19, q08, q03, q14 worst). Acceptance needs a gain beyond the template's noise (q04 needed -20.7%).

## Profile snapshot: q18 666, q13 570, q09 493, q04 272, q05 238, q08 231, q22 201, q03 196, q07 195, q17 193, q19 172, q16 168, q14 167, q02 103. Geomean 239.6.
- q05: lineitem scan with BF 2.03M rows; l_orderkey=o_orderkey HJ 0.32s.
- q13: inner agg on c_custkey 15M → 1.5M groups; orders scan FSST decode.
- q18: second lineitem scan emits 12.1M rows despite a 111-key IN-list (optional zonemap filter).
- Storage: lineitem l_orderkey BitPacking DELTA_FOR; dates are BitPacking; o_orderpriority is Dictionary.

## Dead / exhausted
- CM join-key removal (E0017/E0018), HJ prefetch, agg run-collapse, in-place finalize, FSST heap reuse, dictionary filter, scan filter cost ordering, early HT grow, sparse perfect HJ, bitpacking select, BF on sparse perfect HJ, hashed BF through CM offset (+4.7% in a prior run): ~0% or worse.
- Large perfect HA: real q13 gain, but the bench flags q18 each time.
- FSST DecompressVector path is not hot (enable_fsst_vectors is off).

## Next candidates
1. Re-dispatch E0019 after the BF-through-offset change lands.
2. Extend the deliminator to ANTI delim joins (NOT EXISTS: q22, q21).
3. DELIM BF gate for IS NOT DISTINCT FROM conds (q17).
4. q18 IN-list optional filter → evaluate per row when the key set is small.
5. q08/q07 not analysed yet.

## Codebase facts
- CM: src/optimizer/compressed_materialization.cpp + compressed_materialization/compress_*.cpp. In release, CM on a join fires only if est. build >= 1M rows and join/build ratio <= 8.
- Rule order: src/optimizer/optimizer.cpp (Deliminator runs before the join order optimizer). Scan-filter cardinality: RelationStatisticsHelper::InspectTableFilter.
- Deliminator: src/optimizer/deliminator.cpp (HasSelection ~:112).
- Join filter generation: JoinFilterPushdownOptimizer::GenerateJoinFilters, join-type switch ~233-240.
- Perfect HJ: perfect_hash_join_executor.cpp:74. Perfect HA: plan_aggregate.cpp. FSST: src/storage/compression/fsst.cpp.
- Noise thresholds: q16 ~7.9%, q18 ~5%, q13 ~14%, q09 ~8.6%, q14 ~5.1%; q04 ~20%; q08/q17 ±5-15%.
- Budget is tight (~$4/session): read memory, the ledger tail and the profile head, then dispatch.
